status: accepted for this finite prospective receiving; not executed by this declaration
scope: Caller-owned serial collection and empirical native docking-score presentation for two stereochemical entities from one complex; no affinity or stereoselectivity inference

common_receptor.scope: Same protein-only rigid receptor for both ligands; historical fixed-companion receptors excluded

common_domain.scope: Joint domain covering different experimental sites, not a common-site affinity experiment

preparation_profile.source_recipe: Public native SDF stereo_engine=rdkit/discard_properties=True, then explicit native/RDKit/native interpretation
preparation_profile.pre_native_gate: Reproduce and compare both admitted source authorities and preparation fields, then require BOTH exact prepared PDBQT hashes before the first native call
preparation_profile.on_reproduction_difference: STOP before native work; preserve actual evidence without repair, substitution or historical relabeling

protocol.seed_policy: Exactly 42 for both scientific runs; no index-derived seed or reseeding
protocol.weights_policy: Pinned inspected Vina 1.2.7 defaults below; no set_weights call; retain and compare the actual reported weights
protocol.grid_policy: Pinned inspected wrapper defaults below; preserve and compare actual resolved grid spacing, voxel/domain settings and native calls

run_sequence.role: expected_capability_refusal; same P59 state/preparation, not a third ligand

execution_and_custody.pose_identity: Caller run_id plus original result-local pose_id; retain original pose index and rank
execution_and_custody.unexpected_ordinary_item_error: Persist and continue serial consumption; diagnose qualification after available outcomes are retained
execution_and_custody.interruption: Preserve partial outcomes and not-attempted/unknown stages; stop only owned work

native_score_record.required_row_binding: One original finite five-column energy row per returned pose; all four public scores agree with their own row
native_score_record.reference_policy: Retain the actual reported best-pose intramolecular reference for EACH native search; no common reference across different ligands asserted

study_comparison.representative: Unique original backend rank-1 pose of each nonempty successful scientific result, linked to backend-origin ranking history
study_comparison.ties: Exact equality of reported native canonical totals; retain tied groups, input position only for stable presentation
study_comparison.display_units: Explicit public physical conversion for presentation; display rounding never changes selection, ties or order
required_shared_context: actual weights and resolved native grid settings
fixed receptor bytes and external receptor state
fixed physical joint domain and actual backend projection
declared search protocol and native docking-score semantics
study_comparison.required_per_run_binding: Each result matches its own registered source/state/prepared hash, captured native input and original records
study_comparison.missing_or_incompatible: Retain explicit reason and no numeric order/imputation; never force two comparable rows
study_comparison.two_ligand_order_complete_only_if: Both scientific outcomes have eligible original-rank-1 representatives and admitted study context
study_comparison.interpretation: Case-specific empirical model preference, not affinity, stereoselectivity, enrichment, calibrated uncertainty or screening effectiveness

count_scope: Registered direct requests/native Python API calls. Observe internal provider calls, backend staging exports and search-internal calculations separately. Input-gate exports do not count backend-internal staging exports. Two nonempty successful runs reach positive native caps; empty/failing results remain retained and incomplete without retry.

delivery_boundary.next_gate: Freeze policy with exact notebook/worker/guard/artifact identities and register before execution; receive immutable outcomes and an independent standard-library reader afterwards

study_report_contract.producer: Case-specific pure caller notebook function over saved outcome/result dictionaries; no runtime API
study_report_contract.inputs: Policy plus the three already persisted outcome dictionaries and their recorded byte/capture bindings
study_report_contract.outcome_records: Three ordered references with run_id, input_position, outcome artifact path and exact SHA-256; retain all original outcomes unchanged
study_report_contract.missing_fields: Use null where evidence is absent; retain explicit reasons rather than inventing values
study_report_contract.order_groups: Ascending eligible native totals; each equal-value group retains source-position presentation order and original run/pose attribution
study_report_contract.counts: Keep submitted/attempted/outcome/failure/refusal/empty/pose/selected/eligible/incomparable populations explicit without inflating the two-ligand denominator
study_report_contract.complete_two_ligand_order: True only when both scientific representatives and shared-context policy are admitted from actual records; never accepted as a caller-trust input
study_report_contract.purity: No engines, molecular operations, file mutation, rescoring, reranking of source results, or use of same-state comparison APIs
study_report_contract.source_immutability: Retain exact original file identities and compare caller input dictionaries before/after report construction

observed_native_defaults.scope: Inspected defaults of the pinned Vina 1.2.7 Python wrapper, to be captured from actual calls; no extra calls or new DockingMT protocol options

public_outcome_roundtrip.population: All three original outcome dictionaries, only after all three outcomes are persisted
preserve: input position and caller run/state associations
success/failure payload and original error summary
original result/pose IDs, ranks, all scores, metadata and histories
physical coordinates and original input dictionary nonmutation
public_outcome_roundtrip.representation_policy: Compare all non-coordinate scientific fields without weakening their meaning; compare coordinates physically through explicit public units, retaining original and restored wire records
public_outcome_roundtrip.scope: Actual public record restoration of this new population; separate from the later independent standard-library reader
